headline: Instagram lets users edit Stories after posting
summary: Instagram now lets users edit a Story after posting, without losing views, likes or replies, within a 15-minute window to change text, music, stickers and drawings; the feature was announced by Instagram head Adam Mosseri.

claims.statement: Instagram now lets users edit a Story after posting without deleting it or losing views, likes, or replies.

sources.quote: You can finally edit an Instagram Story without deleting it
will allow you to edit your Stories without losing your views, likes, or replies.

claims.statement: Users have a 15-minute window after posting to edit text, music, stickers, and drawings.

sources.quote: There's a 15-minute window to fix typos and make other changes.
You can now edit the text, music, stickers, and drawings for up to 15 minutes after sharing your Story

claims.statement: Instagram head Adam Mosseri announced the feature, which a reverse engineer had spotted in development in April.

sources.quote: Instagram head Adam Mosseri has announced.
Reverse engineer Alessandro Paluzzi first spotted Instagram working on this feature in April
